community.activity.eventsThisYear: The unit words after a community's event count in the directory, which is drawn as a figure before them; {n} only picks the plural.
community.activity.lastRan: Before the month and day a community last held an event, when it has none this year.
community.activity.none: Activity cell for a community that has never held an event.
community.board.allTime: What a community's board is counted over when it runs seasons and none is picked; {name} is the community.
community.board.column.country: Community board column: the player's country flag.
community.board.column.events: Community board column: how many events the player has entered.
community.board.column.gain: Community board column heading for rating movement over the last {days} days. "d" abbreviates days and Δ is the change sign; keep it as short as the English.
community.board.column.main: Community board column: the character the player mostly plays.
community.board.column.player: Community board column: the player's name.
community.board.column.rating: Community board column: the player's rating.
community.board.column.winRate: Community board column: the share of sets the player has won.
community.board.empty: Empty state of a community's rating board.
community.board.emptySeason: Empty state of a season's board; {season} is the season's name.
community.board.header.allTime: Season picker tab on a community board for the board counted over every season.
community.board.header.rankedIn: Words after the count of ranked players over a community board, which is drawn as a figure before them. {population} is the community or season the board counts, or community.board.allTime.
community.board.header.season: Label of the season picker on a community board.
community.board.header.settling: On a board's summary line: the season picked is still under way and too young to be the default board.
community.board.header.to: Between the start and end dates of a season on a board's summary line, as in "1 Jan 2026 to 31 Mar 2026".
community.board.header.updated: Before the date a board was last recalculated, on its summary line.
community.board.leader.allTime: Label under the name of the player at the top of a community's all-time board, when the community also runs seasons.
community.board.leader.label: Label under the name of the player at the top of a board.
community.board.leader.season: Label under the name of the player at the top of a season's board; {season} is the season's name.
community.board.leader.sets: The board leader's set record: sets won, en-dash, sets lost.
community.board.noPlayers: Community board: nothing matched the search or filters.
community.board.search: Search box on a community board.
community.board.sort.alphabetical: Sort option on a community board: by player name.
community.board.sort.events: Sort option on a community board: by events entered.
community.board.sort.rating: Sort option on a community board: by rating.
community.board.sort.recentGain: Sort option on a community board: by rating gained recently.
community.board.sort.winRate: Sort option on a community board: by share of sets won.
community.board.waiting.pending: Warning under a board's summary, after the number of brackets drawn as a figure before it. The count clears by itself within minutes, so "yet" matters.
community.board.waiting.walkUps: Under a board's summary, after the number of brackets drawn as a figure before it: brackets held back because some players are walk-ups nobody has matched to a profile yet. Unlike community.board.waiting.pending it needs a person, so it promises nothing.
community.criteria.blurb.distance: Beside the filter word distance: in the community directory's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
community.criteria.blurb.game: Beside the filter word game: in the community directory's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
community.criteria.blurb.online: Beside the filter word online: in the community directory's filter list. Lower case, no full stop.
community.criteria.online.no: A value of the online: filter in the community directory: communities that do not play online.
community.criteria.online.yes: A value of the online: filter in the community directory: communities that play online.
community.crosstable.add.label: Accessible name of the crosstable's add-a-player search.
community.crosstable.add.placeholder: Placeholder of the crosstable's add-a-player search.
community.crosstable.cell.record: Tooltip on a crosstable cell. {player} is the row's player, {opponent} the column's, {wins}–{losses} the sets between them from the row player's side, and {window} the season or period the board covers.
community.crosstable.cell.unplayed: Tooltip on an empty crosstable cell; {window} is the season or period the board covers.
community.crosstable.column.rank: Crosstable heading over the players' board ranks.
community.crosstable.column.vsField: Crosstable column: each player's record against everyone else in the grid.
community.crosstable.next: Crosstable button adding the next {n} players on the board to the grid.
community.crosstable.remove.label: Accessible name of the button that takes a player off the crosstable; {name} is the player.
community.crosstable.remove.title: Tooltip of the button that takes a player off the crosstable; {name} is the player.
community.crosstable.tooFew.body: Body of the crosstable's empty state.
community.crosstable.tooFew.title: Title of the crosstable's empty state.
community.crosstable.top: Crosstable button resetting the grid to the board's top {n} players.
community.directory.awayFromYou: Screen-reader words after a distance in the communities table, as in "41 km away from you".
community.directory.column.activity: Communities table column: how many events it ran this year.
community.directory.column.community: Communities table column: the community's name and place.
community.directory.column.distance: Communities table column: how far it is from the viewer.
community.directory.column.follow: Communities table column holding the follow button.
community.directory.column.games: Communities table column: the games it runs.
community.directory.column.next: Communities table column: its next event.
community.directory.column.ranked: Communities table column: how many players its board ranks.
community.directory.description: Search-engine and link-preview description of the communities directory. Dizzy is the site's name.
community.directory.everyGame: Eyebrow over the communities directory when no game narrows it.
community.directory.nearYou: Heading over the communities close to the viewer.
community.directory.next: Before the date of a community's next event on its directory card.
community.directory.none.body: Body of the empty communities directory.
community.directory.none.title: Title of the empty communities directory.
community.directory.online: In place of a town, for a community that meets online.
community.directory.seeAll: Link to the full list of nearby communities; {n} is how many there are.
community.directory.sort.name: Sort choice: alphabetical.
community.directory.sort.size: Sort choice: most ranked players first.
community.directory.suggestHeading: Heading over search suggestions drawn from the communities directory.
community.directory.title: Title of the communities directory, and its browser tab.
community.directory.worldwide: Chip on a directory row for a community that plays anywhere, not only online.
community.directory.worldwideHeading: Heading over the communities that play online or have no one place.
community.error.body: Error page when a community fails to load.
community.error.eyebrow: Eyebrow of a community's error page.
community.error.home: Link from a community's error page to the home page.
community.error.retry: Error page advice; the reference is an error code shown under it.
community.error.title: Title of a community's error page.
community.meta.board.description: Search-engine description of a community's board; {name} is the community, {game} the game.
community.meta.board.title: Page title of a community's rating board; {game} is the game.
community.meta.crosstable.description: Search-engine description of a community's crosstable; {name} is the community.
community.meta.crosstable.title: Page title: a grid of head-to-head records between a board's leading players.
community.meta.panel.description: Search-engine description of a community's panel; {name} is the community.
community.meta.panel.title: Page title: a side-by-side comparison of a board's leading players.
community.meta.powerRanking.description: Search-engine description of a community's power ranking; {name} is the community, {game} the game.
community.meta.powerRanking.title: Page title: the ranking a community's own panel votes on.
community.meta.tournaments.description: Search-engine description of a community's tournament archive; {name} is the community, {game} the game.
community.meta.tournaments.title: Page title of a community's tournament archive.
community.meta.upcoming.description: Search-engine description of a community's upcoming events; {name} is the community, {game} the game.
community.meta.upcoming.title: Page title of a community's upcoming events.
community.noBoard.communities: Link to the communities directory, offered when a community has no board in this game.
community.noBoard.elsewhere: Heading over the way out of a community with no board at all.
community.noBoard.keep: Heading over links that keep one thing the reader arrived with; {name} is a community or a game.
community.noBoard.none.body: Body shown when a community has no ranked activity at all.
community.noBoard.none.title: Title shown when a community has no ranked activity at all.
community.noBoard.otherGame.body: Body shown when a community does not run the game the reader picked.
community.noBoard.otherGame.title: Title shown when a community does not run the game the reader picked.
community.noBoard.wholeGame.players: Link to the game's whole player list, with no community narrowing it.
community.noBoard.wholeGame.tournaments: Link to the game's whole tournament list, with no community narrowing it.
community.noBoard.wholeGame.upcoming: Link to everything coming up in the game, with no community narrowing it.
community.panel.alone.matchups: Heading over one player's set records against the others in the field.
community.panel.alone.matchupsPagination: Accessible name of the page control under the panel's matchups.
community.panel.alone.noLoss: The panel's worst-loss line when the player has none.
community.panel.alone.noMatchups: The panel's matchups list when the player met nobody in the field.
community.panel.alone.noPlacements: The panel's placements list when the player entered nothing.
community.panel.alone.noWin: The panel's best-win line when the player has none.
community.panel.alone.placementsPaginati: Accessible name of the page control under the panel's placements.
community.panel.alone.scalps: Heading over one player's best win and worst loss on the board.
community.panel.best: Screen-reader note after the leading win rate among the players compared.
community.panel.chart.caption: Caption of the table that stands in for the panel's rating chart for screen readers.
community.panel.chart.describe.placed: Part of a cell in the rating chart's text table; {placement} is a finish such as "3rd of 24".
community.panel.chart.describe.ranked: Part of a cell in the rating chart's text table: where the player stood on the board after that tournament.
community.panel.chart.notRated: Cell in the rating chart's text table for a player who was not at that tournament.
community.panel.chart.placeOf: A finish with its field size; {place} is an ordinal such as "3rd".
community.panel.chart.rating: Name of the rating series in the panel's chart.
community.panel.chart.tooltip.placed: Chart tooltip line; {placement} is a finish such as "3rd of 24".
community.panel.chart.tooltip.ranked: Chart tooltip line: where the player stood on the board after that tournament.
community.panel.chart.tournament: Stand-in name for a tournament the chart cannot name, and the heading of its text table's first column.
community.panel.clear: Button deselecting every player in the panel.
community.panel.column.compare: Screen-reader heading over the panel's tick-to-compare column.
community.panel.column.player: Panel table column: the player's name.
community.panel.column.rating: Panel table column: the player's rating.
community.panel.column.sets: Panel table column: sets won and lost.
community.panel.column.vsField: Panel table column: record against the rest of the board's top players.
community.panel.compareLabel: Accessible name of the tick that adds a player to the comparison.
community.panel.comparing: Label before the chips of the players being compared, when there are two or more.
community.panel.empty: The panel's record side before anyone is picked.
community.panel.entrants: A tournament's field size in the panel's compact placement list; "ent" abbreviates entrants. Keep it as short.
community.panel.figure: Screen-reader heading over the row labels of a comparison table.
community.panel.floor: Line above the Panel view's player list when the community asks for more tournaments there than on the board itself. {n} is that number, always 2 or more.
community.panel.headlines.againstField: Comparison row: set record against the board's top players.
community.panel.headlines.boardRank: Comparison row: each player's rank on the board.
community.panel.headlines.captionMany: Screen-reader caption of the headline comparison table.
community.panel.headlines.captionOne: Screen-reader caption of the headline table when one player is picked.
community.panel.headlines.eventsEntered: Comparison row: events each player entered.
community.panel.headlines.fieldHint: Small note under the "Against the field" row naming the field it counts: the board's top {n} players.
community.panel.headlines.poolRating: Comparison row: each player's rating on this board.
community.panel.headlines.sets: Comparison row: sets won and lost.
community.panel.noPlayers: The panel's player list when its search matches nobody, or on a page past the end of the board.
community.panel.placements: Heading over where a player, or the players compared, finished.
community.panel.rating: Heading over the panel's rating chart.
community.panel.record: Label before the chip of the one player whose record is shown.
community.panel.remove: Accessible name of the button taking a player out of the comparison.
community.panel.selectedRecord: Accessible name of the panel's side column holding the picked players' records.
community.panel.status.comparing: Screen-reader status in the comparison panel once more than one player is picked; {names} is the list of their names, already joined.
community.panel.status.showing: Screen-reader status in the comparison panel when one player is picked; {name} is the player.
community.panel.strength: A bracket's strength figure in the panel; "str" abbreviates strength. Keep it as short.
community.panel.together.didNotEnter: Tooltip on the dot marking a player who was not at that bracket.
community.panel.together.event: Heading over the bracket names in the shared placements table.
community.panel.together.headToHead: Heading over the grid of sets between the compared players.
community.panel.together.headToHeadCapti: Screen-reader caption of the head-to-head grid.
community.panel.together.noShared: Shared placements when the compared players never entered the same bracket.
community.panel.together.sharedCaption: Screen-reader caption of the shared placements table.
community.panel.together.unmet: Tooltip on an empty cell of the head-to-head grid.
community.panel.unknownBracket: Stand-in for a bracket the panel cannot name.
community.panel.unrated: In place of a strength figure, for a bracket with none.
community.powerRanking.boardRank: Beside a power-ranking entry: where the rating board placed the same player; {rank} is the board position, emphasised as a figure.
community.powerRanking.empty: Empty state of a published power ranking.
community.powerRanking.honourableMention: The words after the figure counting a power ranking's honourable mentions; {n} only picks the plural.
community.powerRanking.mark.mention: Accessible name and tooltip of the HM mark beside a player's name; {season} is the power ranking's season.
community.powerRanking.mark.ranked: Accessible name and tooltip of the number mark beside a player's name: their place in the community's power ranking for {season}.
community.powerRanking.mentionsHeading: Heading over a power ranking's honourable mentions.
community.powerRanking.panellists.headin: Heading over the people credited with making a power ranking.
community.powerRanking.pictureBy: Caption under a power ranking's picture; {names} is a comma-separated list of the people credited with making it.
community.powerRanking.result.entered: In place of a finishing position for a tournament entry with no result yet.
community.powerRanking.result.lost: Screen-reader word before a set the player lost.
community.powerRanking.result.placement: Where a player finished in a tournament; {place} is already an ordinal ('1st'), {field} is how many entered.
community.powerRanking.result.score: A set's games from the entry's side, {mine} first.
community.powerRanking.result.vs: One set under a highlighted result, naming the opponent; the score follows separately.
community.powerRanking.result.won: Screen-reader word before a set the player won.
community.powerRanking.results.heading: Eyebrow over the tournament results an entry's write-up points at.
community.powerRanking.status.published: Before the date a power ranking was published, on its status line.
community.powerRanking.status.ranked: Start of a power ranking's status line: how many players it ranks. The bold part is drawn as a figure.
community.powerRanking.unranked: Beside a power-ranking entry whose player the rating board does not rank.
community.powerRanking.writtenBy: Byline under one entry's write-up; {names} is a comma-separated list of its writers.
community.provenance.both: A community's one-line summary of what it collects from elsewhere, when it takes both other communities and single events. The two halves are community.provenance.communities (or a list of names) and community.provenance.events.
community.provenance.communities: Half of the provenance line: how many other communities it collects.
community.provenance.events: Half of the provenance line: how many single events it has pinned.
community.provenance.namedAndMore: Half of the provenance line: up to two community names, comma-separated, then how many more.
community.provenance.one: A community's provenance line when it collects only one kind of thing.
community.provisional.queueLink: Link to the provisional-players queue, shown to staff beside a board; a decorative arrow follows it.
community.rail.allTournaments: Link under a community's recent results to its full tournament list.
community.rail.nextUp: Heading over a community's next event in its side column.
community.rail.recentResults: Heading over a community's latest finished tournaments in its side column.
community.rail.wonBy: Under a recent tournament's name; followed by a comma and the entrant count.
community.reading.board: Switch between a board's readings: the ranking itself.
community.reading.crosstable: Switch between a board's readings: the head-to-head grid.
community.reading.field.matching: Status line of a reading narrowed by its search: how many players match, of how many on the board. Bold parts are drawn as figures.
community.reading.field.picked: Status line of a crosstable whose players the reader chose: how many are in it, of how many on the board. Bold parts are drawn as figures.
community.reading.field.range: Status line of a paged reading: which board places this page shows, of how many.
community.reading.field.top: Status line of a reading that draws the top of the board.
community.reading.label: Accessible name of the switch between a board's readings.
community.reading.panel: Switch between a board's readings: the side-by-side comparison.
community.reading.powerRanking: Switch between a board's readings: the community's own ranking.
community.seasons.noBoard.title: Tooltip on a season tab the community has no board for. {game} is the game, {season} the season.
community.tabs.noBoard.note: Short note on a game tab the community has no board for.
community.tabs.noBoard.title: Tooltip on a game tab the community has no board for. {community} is the community, {game} the game.
